/\ cpc' = "failed"
               /\ UNCHANGED <<wpc, finished, resume, stopEv, thread, lease,

/\ cpc' = "failed" /\ thread' = FALSE
               /\ UNCHANGED <<wpc, finished, resume, stopEv, lease,

replace: /\ writer' = "none" /\ lease' = FALSE /\ manual' = FALSE /\ cpc' = "done"
/\ writer' = writer /\ lease' = FALSE /\ manual' = FALSE /\ cpc' = "done"
